{"reason":"v1 has accuracy 0.708, 23 unknowns, and 0.607 recovery. Broaden the demand test to market-signal mismatch or forecast bias above 0.05, after the supplier branch. This addresses listed unknowns with mismatch=#t and biases 0.065–0.081, preserves supplier-first classifications, and should increase recovered amount.","source":"(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
         (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05)))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
